text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.262 for the AI Software Developer position. Their strongest evidence includes a computer science degree and experience with "SQL" and "Docker" for containerisation. Key gaps include the absence of machine learning, C#, .NET, JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, and NoSQL. Despite the low fit and missing must-have requirements, the application has been escalated for further review due to the candidate's 5.54 years of relevant experience.
